safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Changing/omitting the specific safety-net threshold for when to seek follow-up ("more than 8" episodes with dehydration risk and to book an appointment) can lead to inappropriate escalation or delayed reassessment depending on how the patient applies the advice.
